quantity.name: lamella thickness
quantity.definition: specimen thickness (videoextensometer); length and width (gauge) in extra keys

source.authors: Holzapfel GA, Schulze-Bauer CAJ, Feigl G, Regitnig P
source.sample: 11 lumbar body-disc-body units from 11 cadavers (6 grade I, 5 grade II); single-lamella specimens VLe n=11, VLi n=9, De n=11, Di n=8, cross-fibre n=7; fibre angles from the second hemidisc

protocol.summary: Single lamellar AF specimens cut along the fibre direction with bone segments at both ends (bone clamped; cross-fibre specimens clamped with emery paper), load-free configuration set in bath; 0.15 mol/l NaCl at 37 C, tested within 24 h of autopsy; 30 min equilibration; cyclic uniaxial extension at crosshead 1 mm/min then 10 and 0.1 mm/min; 5 preconditioning cycles (1 and 10 mm/min); stretch from videoextensometer gauge markers; engineering stress = force / undeformed area. Moduli = dT/dlambda on loading curve within stress bands 0-100 kPa (Elow), 100-500 kPa (Emedium), 500 kPa-1 MPa (Ehigh).
how_to_simulate: Use as specimen geometry for the fibre-direction tests; compare model lamella thickness

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
